_about: Nerve, arterial and venous supply of limb muscles for the atlas info card. Keys are model structure names. n / a / v = nerve / artery / vein: t = text shown to the learner, m = model parts to light up (same side as the tapped muscle). Check any change against the lecture notes or a textbook.
